en_title: Sony Announces Official Marvel's Wolverine Sales Figure for the First Time, Raises PlayStation Sales Forecast With GTA 6 Imminent
cn_title: 索尼首次公布《Marvel's金刚狼》官方销量，随着《GTA6》即将推出上调PlayStation销售额预期
opus_summary: 索尼首次公布《漫威金刚狼》官方销量：截至11月4日，游戏发售50天后销量突破240万份。索尼将游戏及网络服务部门的销售和利润预测均上调6%，并表示正在为下一代平台做准备。

paragraphs.en: Sony has raised its sales forecast for its gaming business, while announcing an official sales figure for Marvel’s Wolverine for the first time.
paragraphs.cn: 索尼上调了游戏业务的销售额预期，同时首次公布了《Marvel’s金刚狼》的官方销量。

paragraphs.en: Sony said it had raised the sales forecast for its Game & Network Services Segment, which includes PlayStation, by 6% due to an “increase in sales of non-first-party game software titles.” Similarly, Sony raised the profit forecast for its gaming business by 6%, also citing the impact of an increase in sales of non-first-party games, but adding in an improvement in costs, and the impact of sales from network services (PlayStation Plus, etc).
paragraphs.cn: 索尼表示，由于「非第一方游戏软件作品的销售额增加」，公司将包括PlayStation在内的游戏与网络服务部门销售额预期上调了6%。同样，索尼将游戏业务的利润预期上调了6%，原因也包括非第一方游戏销售额增加的影响，此外还包括成本改善以及网络服务（PlayStation Plus等）销售额的影响。

paragraphs.en: Now, we all know what Sony is talking about here, or at least what it is mostly talking about: Grand Theft Auto 6. Sony’s partnership with Rockstar Games for GTA 6 has seen the PS5 at the forefront of the game’s marketing, so much so that the casual observer might not even know the game is also coming to Xbox Series X and S . Gameplay shown so far is from PS5 only, and marketing material says GTA 6 “plays best on PS5.”
paragraphs.cn: 现在，我们都知道索尼在这里说的是什么，或者至少知道它主要说的是什么：《GTA6》。索尼与Rockstar就《GTA6》展开的合作，让PS5在这款游戏的营销中处于最显眼的位置，以至于不太关注的人可能甚至不知道这款游戏也会登陆XBOX Series X和S。目前展示的游戏实机画面仅来自PS5，宣传材料则称《GTA6》「在PS5上的游玩体验最佳」。

paragraphs.en: Dragging profits down during the forecast for the current financial year, which ends March 31, 2027, is the delay to Sony Santa Monica’s God of War Laufey from February to May . But with GTA 6 set to become the biggest entertainment launch of all time, Sony will no doubt be comfortable with the sales shift into its next financial year.
paragraphs.cn: 索尼Santa Monica的《战神：劳菲》从2月延期至5月，拉低了截至2027年3月31日的本财年利润预期。但随着《GTA6》有望成为有史以来规模最大的娱乐产品发行，索尼无疑会乐于接受销售额转移到下一财年。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, Sony said Marvel’s Wolverine sales had exceeded 2.4 million units. That’s as of November 4 — or 50 days after launch. To put that into context, fellow PS5 exclusive Ghost of Yotei sold 3.3 million units in 32 days, or just over a month after going on sale in October last year. Astro Bot had sold 1.5 million copies 58 days after going on sale in 2024.
paragraphs.cn: 与此同时，索尼表示，《Marvel’s金刚狼》的销量已超过240万份。这是截至11月4日，也就是发售50天后的数据。作为参照，同为PS5独占游戏的《羊蹄山之魂》在32天内售出330万份，也就是去年10月发售一个多月后。《宇宙机器人》在2024年发售58天后售出了150万份。

paragraphs.en: Marvel’s Wolverine is well behind Insomniac’s previous game, Marvel’s Spider-Man 2, which sold a huge 2.5 million on day one (October 2023), 5 million just 11 days after launch, and 10 million after 107 days. The big question for Wolverine will be how well it continues to sell, with the crucial holiday season coming up.
paragraphs.cn: 《Marvel’s金刚狼》远远落后于Insomniac的上一款游戏《Marvel’s蜘蛛侠2》，后者在首日（2023年10月）就售出了高达250万份，发售仅11天后销量达到500万份，107天后达到1000万份。随着关键的假日季即将到来，《Marvel’s金刚狼》面临的重大问题将是其后续销量表现如何。

paragraphs.en: Here’s what Sony had to say about Wolverine today:
paragraphs.cn: 以下是索尼今天对《Marvel’s金刚狼》所说的话：

paragraphs.en: “Regarding first-party titles, cumulative sales of Marvel’s Wolverine, released in September, exceeded 2.4 million units, contributing to the improved results of the entire segment for the quarter. We leveraged our expertise building the Marvel’s Spider-Man franchise to create a differentiated action game experience for Marvel’s Wolverine. Users have praised the new title for its highly immersive action, high-quality production, and richly layered storytelling.”
paragraphs.cn: 「在第一方作品方面，9月发售的《Marvel’s金刚狼》累计销量超过240万份，为整个部门本季度业绩的改善做出了贡献。我们运用打造《Marvel’s蜘蛛侠》系列所积累的专业经验，为《Marvel’s金刚狼》创造了与众不同的动作游戏体验。用户称赞这款新作的动作体验极具沉浸感、制作精良，叙事层次丰富。」

paragraphs.en: PS5 sales continue to decline, as Sony had said they would at this stage of the console’s lifecycle, but the company insisted “the PS platform continues to expand and grow in a stable manner.”
paragraphs.cn: PS5销量持续下滑，正如索尼此前所说，在主机生命周期的这一阶段销量会出现下滑，但该公司强调「PS平台继续稳定扩张和增长」。

paragraphs.en: And there was a brief note on its plans for the next generation of hardware, which is expected to involve a PS6 and possibly a handheld. “Looking ahead to next fiscal year, we aim to continue to enhance user engagement and further strengthen monetization through the release of strong titles and the expansion of our service. We also intend to make solid progress in preparing for the next generation platform.”
paragraphs.cn: 索尼还简要提及了下一代硬件的计划，预计其中包括PS6，也可能包括一款掌机。「展望下一财年，我们旨在通过推出强劲的作品和扩大服务，继续提升用户参与度并进一步加强变现能力。我们还打算在下一代平台的准备工作上取得扎实进展。」

paragraphs.en: Other notable financial results include the number of monthly active users (MAUs) across the PlayStation platform increasing 7% in September compared to the same month of the previous fiscal year to 127 million accounts — that’s a record high for September. Sony said this indicates “the baseline of engagement is steadily improving.”
paragraphs.cn: 其他值得注意的财务业绩包括，PlayStation平台9月的月活跃用户数（MAU）较上一财年同期增长7%，达到1.27亿个账户，创下9月的历史新高。索尼表示，这表明「用户参与度的基准水平正在稳步提高」。

paragraphs.en: Sony has of course raised the price of PS5 in response to memory scarcity fueled by the AI boom, but it downplayed the impact on its bottom line. “With regard to PlayStation (PS5) hardware, we have been able to offset the rise in memory prices through adjustments to promotions and pricing, as well as additional cost-reduction, and we expect hardware profitability for the current fiscal year to remain on par with the previous fiscal year,” it said.
paragraphs.cn: 当然，面对AI热潮加剧的内存供应短缺，索尼已经上调了PS5的价格，但它淡化了这对利润的影响。该公司表示：「在PlayStation（PS5）硬件方面，我们通过调整促销和定价，以及进一步削减成本，得以抵消内存价格上涨的影响，预计本财年的硬件盈利能力将与上一财年持平。」

paragraphs.en: “Regarding memory procurement for next fiscal year, based on discussions held so far with various suppliers, we have aligned on the quantity of memory needed for our projected hardware unit sales,” it continued.
paragraphs.cn: 该公司接着表示：「关于下一财年的内存采购，根据迄今与各家供应商进行的讨论，我们已就满足预计硬件销量所需的内存数量达成一致。」
